faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Ropar Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) post at IIT Ropar is 20 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Ropar Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) post in the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026. This is a single opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) posts at IIT Ropar is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) post is 25 years. Candidates must meet this age criterion to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.Sc./BCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications or a related discipline, along with practical knowledge in digital administration and web technologies.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Ropar Intern Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Ropar Intern (Digital and Media Administration) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) post involves CV Shortlisting followed by an In-person Interaction. Candidates will be evaluated based on these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Intern position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) position at IIT Ropar is Contract. This offers a specific tenure for the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Intern post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Intern (Digital and Media Administration) post is Rupnagar, Punjab, within the Indian Institute Of Technology Ropar campus.
